hypotheses.statement: Test coordinated prefill release only if measured mixed-step interference survives tuning the existing scheduler and static prefill interval. PR #61834 supplies a concrete per-step coordination protocol, but its reported interactivity gains come from an earlier MI355X branch and include substantial TTFT penalties; PR #51199 reinforces the need for a static comparator. Adapt the policy to each DP4 replica with MBT16384 and add an agreed wall-clock escape so protected decode periods cannot indefinitely postpone expensive chunks. Keep the CPU collective implementation fixed during this experiment. The prediction is fewer disruptive mixed steps, not an automatic throughput gain; promotion requires a better TTFT/TPOT frontier after accounting for queueing and coordination overhead.

hypotheses.statement: Test exact-size registration of CPU-offloaded Engram tables only after resolving whether this deployment uses private DP shards or shared host storage.
